evidence: Using the local stanza 1.9.2 codebase, the Portuguese tokenizer splits 'exemplo1.com, exemplo2.com e exemplo3.com.br' into multiple sentences. The control case with 'www.' stays as one sentence.
steps: Created an isolated venv and installed the local codebase plus its runtime dependencies.
Downloaded the Portuguese tokenizer resources into a local stanza_resources directory.
Ran a Pipeline(lang='pt', processors='tokenize') on the reported URL example and observed sentence splitting at each dot.
Ran the reported 'www.' control example and observed the expected single sentence.
